references.text: God promises to give the land of Canaan to Abraham and his descendants as an eternal possession, the same promise referred to in Leviticus 14:34.
Describes Israel's entry into the land of Canaan which God gives them, parallel to the promise in Leviticus 14:34.
The land of Canaan is described as the land that God gives the Israelites for a possession.
Describes the land of Canaan as the inheritance Israel will receive, the same concept of a land promise and possession.
Concerns leprosy in garments, related to leprosy in houses mentioned in Leviticus 14:34.
The continuation of the text explaining how to handle leprosy in houses that God sends.
Disease and plagues are mentioned as something God can send upon the people, similar to the idea that God sends leprosy upon houses.
